pitches.signal: Publicly posted 'Designer needed — redesign nisargacare.com without making any changes to the Google index, WhatsApp us'
miniAudit: Their <title> tag is a ~250-character keyword-stuffed string — Google truncates at ~60 chars, so 'Nisarga Care' brand never shows in search results; over-optimization risk on a YMYL medical site
Homepage content is repetitive keyword paragraphs (2010-style SEO text) — exactly what Google's Helpful Content systems demote for healthcare sites
They fear redesign = losing Google ranking — real risk handled by URL-preserving migration: same URLs, 301 map, Search Console monitoring, blog posts untouched
pitches.pitch:
Hi! Saw your post asking for a designer to redesign nisargacare.com WITHOUT disturbing the Google index — that specific constraint is exactly our specialty.

Quick free audit of your current site:
1) Your <title> tag is ~250 keywords long — Google cuts it at ~60, so 'Nisarga Care' never appears in search results. On medical/YMYL sites this over-optimization can actively trigger demotions.
2) Your homepage repeats the same keyword blocks — Google's Helpful Content systems now demote exactly this pattern for healthcare.
3) Your fear (redesign = losing rankings) is solvable: we migrate with URL preservation + 301 redirects + Search Console monitoring, so every existing ranking, blog post and backlink stays intact.

We rebuild the design while KEEPING your Google equity. 1989 ka trust aapka — design hamara kaam.

Scope chat: https://www.garudaos.in/chat?ref=nisargacare
